Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the query by assuming the relevant show was “Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman” and directed research accordingly, ignoring other prominent adaptations featuring Jimmy Olsen (notably Smallville). This led to conflating “developed by” Deborah Joy LeVine with “wrote,” and ultimately to a premature, incorrect finalization. The correct target should have been Smallville, co-created/written by Alfred Gough.
